scripts.test:e2e: dotnet run --project EnergyManagement.Tools -- reset-test-db && playwright test --grep-invert @screenshots
scripts.test:e2e:headed: dotnet run --project EnergyManagement.Tools -- reset-test-db && playwright test --headed --grep-invert @screenshots
scripts.test:e2e:ui: dotnet run --project EnergyManagement.Tools -- reset-test-db && playwright test --ui --grep-invert @screenshots
scripts.generate:api: npm run generate:openapi && npm run generate:api-types
scripts.check:api: npm run check:openapi && npm run generate:api-types && git diff --exit-code Shared/openapi.json energymanagement.client/src/shared/api/generated/openapi-types.ts
scripts.screenshots:vkr: dotnet run --project EnergyManagement.Tools -- reset-test-db && playwright test tests/e2e/vkr-screenshots/vkr-client-screenshots.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep @screenshots
